card.name: End of intra- route words
card.fires_on: The last piece of route words that start with intra-, such as intrathecal, intravesical and intra-amniotic, mostly the ending 'cal', 'ical' or 'otic'. It is weaker on a few stray words like 'administer'.

modes.label: Intra- route endings
modes.description: The final piece that completes intrathecal, intravesical or intra-amniotic in drug route text.
